rows.basis: Growth in gross 'Servers and network assets': 34.330B − 25.584B = 8.746B. This counts all server and network growth, AI and non-AI, net of disposals, and excludes datacenter shells (Buildings, CIP) and finance-lease assets; the company said the capex step-up was server spend 'including for our AI infrastructure'.
Growth in gross 'Servers and network assets': 46.838B − 34.330B = 12.508B. This counts all server and network growth, AI and non-AI, net of disposals; buildings, CIP, and finance leases are excluded.

Growth in gross 'Servers and network assets': 68.397B − 46.838B = 21.559B. The company said server investment included 'both AI and non-AI hardware', so this is an upper-bound proxy for AI compute; it excludes datacenter shells and finance leases.

Growth in gross 'Servers and network assets': 98.040B − 68.397B = 29.643B, covering all servers (core, gen-AI, and non-AI), net of disposals. It excludes the 23.7B jump in construction in progress (training-cluster datacenters), finance-lease assets, and the off-balance-sheet Hyperion JV.

Guidance of $115-135B, later narrowed to $130-145B including finance-lease principal, is total capex 'to support our AI efforts and core business'. The 10-K says AI 'will require significantly increased investment in infrastructure', but no AI amount or share is given.
The 10-K MD&A cites 'significant investments in AI initiatives' within R&D; no amount or share is given.
The 10-K MD&A cites 'significant investments in AI initiatives'. Management called AI the 'biggest investment area in 2024 -- both in engineering and compute', but gave no amount.

The FY2025 opex increase was 'mostly due to higher employee compensation and infrastructure costs related to research and development, including our AI initiatives', with compensation growth 'particularly AI talent' (MSL hires). No amount is given.
Expense growth in 2026 is attributed to infrastructure costs, then employee compensation including a full year of 2025 AI-talent hires and 2026 hires 'particularly AI'. No amount is given.
